title: Get Your Marketing Holiday Ready with Campaign Autopilot
summary: Autopilot runs AI-powered campaigns from your Shopify admin. Set your budget, approve what goes live, and learn from what's happening as it works.
body_markdown:
Black Friday Cyber Monday (BFCM) is one of the busiest shopping weekends of the year and it's right around the corner. Shoppers start researching new deals weeks before sales go live, and the stores they find early are often the ones they come back to when it's time to buy. During BFCM 2025, Shopify store owners generated a record[$14.6 billion in sales, up 27% from the year before](https://www.shopify.com/news/bfcm-data-2025) . Running a successful marketing strategy and getting noticed by shoppers across channels can feel like a full-time job on top of running a business.


Campaign Autopilot can take on more of that work this year. We'll cover what's new in Campaign Autopilot, why the weeks before the holidays are the right time to turn it on, and how to set it up so your campaigns are ready when shoppers are.


## What is Campaign Autopilot?


Autopilot is a way for you to automatically run your marketing, built directly into Shopify admin. It uses AI to run marketing on your behalf across channels like Meta, Microsoft Advertising, Snapchat, Shop, email, and soon X Ads.


You set a monthly budget, add guardrails, and choose whether to approve campaigns before they go live. Campaign Autopilot handles the rest. It creates campaigns, puts your budget where it sees it can perform best, and adjusts over time based on what's working.


## How Campaign Autopilot helps you prepare for the holidays


### Reach shoppers wherever they're browsing


Shoppers are actively looking to make a purchase during the holiday season. This means that they’re searching, scrolling, and comparing products before they buy. Campaign Autopilot runs your marketing campaigns across each of those moments, using AI to optimize performance and put your budget where it performs best across Meta Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Snapchat, Shop Campaigns, email, and soon X Ads. ****


You keep control and choose how involved you want to be. Approve every campaign before it goes live, or give Campaign Autopilot more freedom as you get comfortable with how it works.


### SEO recommendations to grow organic traffic


What’s more, Autopilot automatically suggests SEO optimizations so you improve your online store's visibility in search and grow organic traffic. Review and apply them in Campaign Autopilot, or work with Sidekick.


## Why you should set up Campaign Autopilot now


Setting up early gives Campaign Autopilot time to learn and gives you time to make adjustments.


- **Paid campaigns need a learning period.** Campaign Autopilot needs time to find which audiences, channels, and products perform best for your store.
- **Email automations need time to build momentum.** The earlier they're running, the more shoppers they reach before holiday traffic arrives.
- **Search engines take time to pick up changes.** SEO updates you make now have a better chance of paying off by the holidays.
- **The guardrails you set are easier to tune in a quiet week.** Find the level of control that feels right before the holiday season starts and gives Autopilot the flexibility to make changes within your guardrails.


## How to get started


1. **Connect your channels.** Create new ad accounts or connect ones you already have.
2. **Set your budget and guardrails.** Choose a monthly budget target and decide what needs your approval before it goes live.
3. **Review your automated SEO optimizations.** Apply the ones that make sense for your store.


[Get your marketing BFCM-ready](https://admin.shopify.com/growth/autopilot)


## Use Campaign Autopilot this holiday


You set the budget and the rules. Campaign Autopilot takes it from there, building campaigns, putting your budget to work across channels, and adjusting as it learns what performs. You still stay in control, with more time to focus on the rest of your business.[Get started now](https://admin.shopify.com/growth/autopilot) so you can head into holiday season with your marketing already working for you.


## Campaign Autopilot FAQ


### Is it too late to set up Campaign Autopilot before Black Friday?


No. However, the earlier you turn it on, the more time Campaign Autopilot has to learn what works for your store before the holiday season.


### Will Campaign Autopilot change my existing campaigns?


No. Campaign Autopilot creates its own separate campaigns and leaves your existing ones as they are.


### Can I control what Campaign Autopilot runs?


Yes. You can approve campaigns before they go live, say no to a recommendation, change your budget, or pause at any time.
